explanation: The Detroit River bends here, so Windsor lies on its southern bank. Its centre, at about 42.30° N, sits just south of Detroit's, at about 42.33° N.

claims.text: The centre of Windsor, Ontario, lies further south than the centre of Detroit, Michigan.
Where Windsor faces Detroit, the Detroit River bends so that Windsor lies on its southern bank.
Central Windsor lies at about 42.30° N and central Detroit at about 42.33° N.

Centre to centre the gap is only about 3.5 km of latitude, which is why the explanation gives both figures; the two downtowns face each other across the river with Windsor on the southern bank, so the statement holds for the cities as the stem names them.
